Jason Tools 文件工具箱的 ISO/IEC 27001 與 ISO/I: ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001 compliance support for Jason Tools Document Toolbox: the controls the tool provides, how an organization uses them, and where the records are kept.
合規支援 ISO/IEC 27001 與 42001 | Jason Tools: Compliance support: ISO/IEC 27001 and 42001 | Jason Tools Document Toolbox
ISO/IEC 27001（資訊安全管理）與 ISO/IEC 42001（人工智: ISO/IEC 27001 (information security management) and ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management) certify an organization's management system, not software. This page lists the controls Jason Tools Document Toolbox (the tool) already provides, how an organization uses them, and where the records are kept, as a reference for building the management system and preparing audit evidence.
每一項都對照過程式實際的行為；設定位置以管理區的頁面名稱標示。: Every item has been checked against what the code actually does; settings are referred to by their admin page names.
導入單位的做法與紀錄: What the organization does, and the records
本機帳號、LDAP、Active Directory、OIDC 與 SAML 單: Local accounts, LDAP, Active Directory, and OIDC and SAML single sign-on (alongside local accounts)
在「認證設定」與「SSO 單一登入」接上公司目錄或身分提供者，帳號生命週期由目錄: Connect the company directory or identity provider under "Authentication" and "SSO"; account lifecycle is then managed in the directory
兩步驟驗證（TOTP）；稽核員以帳號密碼登入時一律要求: Two-step verification (TOTP); always required for auditors signing in with a password
依政策要求使用者啟用；稽核員帳號另外建立並啟用兩步驟驗證: Require users to enable it per policy; create separate auditor accounts with two-step verification
登入失敗鎖定：同一帳號 10 分鐘內失敗 5 次、或同一來源 IP 失敗 20: Lockout after failed sign-ins: 5 failures for one account or 20 from one IP within 10 minutes locks for 15 minutes (adjustable by the administrator)
鎖定與解鎖都寫入稽核記錄（<code>login_fail</code>、<co: Lockouts and unlocks are written to the audit log (login_fail, account_locked, user_unlock)
登入有效期 7 天，勾選「記住我」為 30 天；管理員可以讓某個帳號的所有登入立: Sign-ins last 7 days, or 30 days with "Remember me"; the administrator can end all of an account's sign-ins at once
依政策調整有效期；帳號疑似外洩時先讓所有登入失效: Adjust the duration per policy; end all sign-ins first when an account may be compromised
停用帳號時，該帳號所有已登入的工作階段立即失效: Disabling an account ends all of its sessions immediately
離職或調職流程中停用帳號；稽核記錄有 <code>user_update</co: Disable accounts in the leaver and mover process; the audit log has user_update
啟用認證時，帳號被停用或刪除後，屬於該帳號的 API Token 一律被拒: With authentication enabled, API tokens owned by a disabled or deleted account are refused
不必另外撤銷 Token 也不會留下可用的存取: No usable access remains even if the tokens are not revoked separately
目錄同步可自動停用目錄中已停用或已移除的帳號（預設關閉；單次異動超過 20% 時: Directory sync can automatically disable accounts that were disabled or removed in the directory (off by default; a run that would change more than 20% is aborted as a whole)
在「群組管理」的排程目錄同步開啟；每次執行記錄 <code>user_auto_: Turn it on in the scheduled directory sync under "Groups"; each run records user_auto_disable
刪除帳號時一併清除該帳號的工作區檔案: Deleting an account also deletes its workspace files
3. 存取控制與職責分離: 1.3 Access control and separation of duties
以角色授權每一支工具，可指派給個人、群組或 AD 組織單位（OU）；內建管理員、: Each tool is granted through roles, assignable to people, groups or AD organizational units (OU); built-in roles include administrator, general user, records, finance, sales, and legal and security
依職務設計角色；「權限矩陣」頁可檢視誰能用哪些工具: Design roles by job; the "Permission matrix" page shows who can use which tools
稽核員角色：只能查看稽核記錄與歷史紀錄，不能使用任何工具；指派稽核員時自動移除其: Auditor role: can only view the audit log and history, cannot use any tool; assigning it removes all other roles
稽核與管理由不同人員擔任: Auditing and administration are done by different people
表單填寫、用印簽名、浮水印的歷史檔案與上傳記錄只有稽核員能查看，管理員不能查看: Form-filling, stamp and watermark history files and upload records are visible to auditors only, not to administrators
稽核員每次查看都寫入稽核記錄（<code>auditor_view</code>: Every auditor view is written to the audit log (auditor_view)
管理員讀取其他使用者的檔案、作業結果或公文案件時寫入稽核記錄（<code>adm: An administrator reading another user's files, job results or official document cases is written to the audit log (admin_file_override)
角色與權限的每次變更都寫入稽核記錄（<code>perm_change</cod: Every role and permission change is written to the audit log (perm_change, role_*, user_update and others)
存取權限審查時以「設定備份匯出」留存當時的角色與權限設定: For access reviews, keep the role and permission settings of the day with the settings export
上傳的檔案、背景作業與結果、我的工作區、公文撰擬案件、會議摘要與逐字稿都記錄擁有: Uploaded files, background jobs and their results, My workspace, official document cases, meeting summaries and transcripts all record their owner. Other accounts cannot view, download, cancel or change them; guessing another user's IDs is always refused. Automated tests check these rules one by one (see TEST_PLAN_SECURITY.md).
記錄登入成功與失敗、鎖定、登出、帳號與群組與角色變更、權限變更、設定變更、工具使: Records successful and failed sign-ins, lockouts, sign-outs, account, group and role changes, permission changes, settings changes, tool use, downloads of results, administrators reading other users' files, auditor views, database backups and corruption, and retention cleanup
「稽核記錄」頁可依使用者、事件類型、時間篩選並匯出 CSV: The "Audit log" page filters by user, event type and time, and exports CSV
工具使用只記錄檔名、大小、操作與結果，<b>不記錄檔案內容</b>: Tool use records only the file name, size, action and result, never the file content
符合紀錄最小化: Keeps logging to the minimum needed
網頁上沒有修改或刪除稽核記錄的功能，只依保留期限自動清理；調整保留期限本身也會留: The web interface cannot edit or delete audit records; they are only cleaned up by the retention period, and changing that period is itself recorded
依政策設定保留期限（預設 90 天）: Set the retention period per policy (90 days by default)
轉送到 SIEM：syslog（RFC 5424）、CEF、GELF，可同時設定: Forwarding to a SIEM: syslog (RFC 5424), CEF and GELF, to several destinations at once; failed sends are retried automatically and a local audit_forward_failed record is written
在「記錄轉送」設定，長期留存交由 SIEM: Configure it under "Log forwarding" and keep long-term records in the SIEM
下列資料有可設定的保留期限（「檔案保留 / 清理」頁），每 6 小時自動清理一次: The following data has a configurable retention period ("File retention / cleanup" page), cleaned up automatically every 6 hours; administrators can also clean up immediately:
暫存上傳檔與處理中的產出: Temporary uploads and outputs in progress
公文撰擬案件（已刪除的從刪除日起算）: Official document cases (deleted cases count from the deletion date)
「系統狀態」頁列出每位使用者目前佔用的檔案數與容量，可以展開看各類別的明細。: The "System status" page lists each user's current file count and storage, with a breakdown by category.
LLM 伺服器與嵌入服務的金鑰、語音服務的金鑰、OIDC 用戶端密碼與 SAML: Keys for the LLM servers and the embedding service, the speech service key, the OIDC client secret and SAML private key, and the passwords and tokens of notification channels are stored encrypted (Fernet); the key file is readable by the service account only.
Office 轉檔每次使用全新的拋棄式設定檔，並關閉巨集執行: Every Office conversion uses a fresh throwaway profile with macro execution disabled
轉檔有時間上限，逾時連同所有子行程一起終止；以較低的執行優先權與限定的 CPU: Conversions have a time limit and are ended together with all child processes on timeout; they run at lower priority on limited CPU cores so the web interface stays responsive
PDF 隱藏內容掃描在獨立的行程中解析: The PDF hidden-content scan parses files in a separate process
毀損的檔案一律回覆錯誤訊息，不會造成伺服器錯誤: Damaged files get an error message, never a server error
Linux 安裝以專用的服務帳號執行，並套用 systemd 的保護設定（<co: Linux installations run under a dedicated service account with systemd protections (NoNewPrivileges, PrivateTmp, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome); the program directory is read-only to the service itself
<b>文件去識別化</b>：編修模式會連同遮蔽範圍內的圖片像素一起清除，產出的檔: Document de-identification: redaction also clears the image pixels inside the redacted area, so the output cannot be restored (including scans and OCR output).
使用者與權限、稽核記錄兩個資料庫每天自動熱備份，保留 7 份: The user and permission database and the audit log database are hot-backed up daily, keeping 7 copies
將 <code>db_backups</code> 複製到另一台主機或備份系統留: Copy db_backups to another host or backup system
命令列工具 <code>jtdt db-check</code>、<code>j: Command-line tools jtdt db-check, jtdt db-backup and jtdt db-restore check and restore even when the web interface is down
定期演練還原並記錄結果: Rehearse restores regularly and record the results
以 <code>jtdt update</code> 升級時，先檢查磁碟空間並備: Upgrading with jtdt update first checks disk space and backs up the data directory (keeping 3 copies); a failed upgrade restores the previous program version
升級紀錄以 CHANGELOG 對照: Match upgrade records against the CHANGELOG
「設定備份 / 匯入」：全站設定打包匯出，可在另一台主機匯入: "Settings backup / import": export all site settings and import them on another host
搬遷與重建時使用（步驟見 <a href=\"https://github.co: Use it when moving or rebuilding (steps in OPS.md)
所有寫入操作都要求 CSRF 權杖；內容安全政策（CSP）以每次請求產生的 no: Every write requires a CSRF token; the content security policy (CSP) restricts scripts and styles with a per-request nonce.
經 HTTPS 連線時送出 HSTS；登入用的 cookie 標示 <code>: HSTS is sent over HTTPS; the sign-in cookie is HttpOnly, and also Secure over HTTPS.
部署說明建議以反向代理提供 HTTPS，服務本身只綁本機（見 <a href=\: The deployment guide recommends serving HTTPS through a reverse proxy, with the service bound to localhost only (see OPS.md).
每次發行前執行 OWASP ZAP 掃描（未登入與已登入），高、中、低風險項目修: Every release is scanned with OWASP ZAP (signed out and signed in), and ships only when High, Medium and Low findings are all 0.
以 bandit 做靜態掃描，並有 OWASP Top 10 回歸測試；資安測試: Static analysis with bandit and OWASP Top 10 regression tests; the security test items are listed in TEST_PLAN_SECURITY.md.
每一版的變更記錄在 <a href=\"https://github.com/j: Every release is recorded in CHANGELOG.md.
LLM 加值功能<b>預設關閉</b>，由管理員在「LLM 設定」啟用: LLM features are off by default and are turned on by the administrator under "LLM settings"
以「LLM 設定」頁作為 AI 功能清冊，記錄啟用的工具、模型與伺服器: Use the "LLM settings" page as the AI inventory: the tools turned on, the models and the servers
會呼叫 LLM 的工具都列在「LLM 設定」：逐句翻譯、文件翻譯、擷取文字（段落: Every tool that calls an LLM is listed under "LLM settings": sentence translation, document translation, text extraction (paragraph rebuild), form auto-fill (verification), document and text de-identification (extra detection), meeting summary, official document drafting, word count, annotations, document comparison, pre-submission check, OCR, and e-invoices
依用途核准；不需要的工具不啟用: Approve per purpose; leave unneeded tools off
每支工具可指定使用哪一台 LLM 伺服器；指定的伺服器不可用時直接停止，<b>不: Each tool can be assigned its own LLM server; if that server is unavailable the tool stops and never sends to another server
機密等級高的工具指定地端伺服器: Assign on-premises servers to tools that handle confidential documents
OCR 預設在本機辨識（EasyOCR）；另外架設的 GPU OCR 伺服器為選: OCR runs locally by default (EasyOCR); a separate GPU OCR server is optional and off by default
啟用前確認伺服器位置: Confirm where the server is before turning it on
會議錄音轉逐字稿使用另外架設的語音服務：對方以 2 小時內有效的簽章網址取得錄音: Meeting transcription uses a separately deployed speech service: it fetches the recording through a signed link valid for 2 hours, and after the transcript is retrieved and saved the service is told to delete it (within 24 hours at most)
語音服務的位置與留存方式列入資料流紀錄: Record the speech service's location and retention in the data-flow records
格式由程式排定，模型只寫內容；自動檢查草稿裡的金額、數量、日期、時間、法規名稱、: The format is laid out by the program and the model writes only the content; amounts, quantities, dates, times, law names, article numbers, document numbers and approval claims in the draft are checked, and anything without a source is flagged; missing information is marked as a placeholder; references show their purpose and source, and only "substantive basis" items count as a basis for the draft; every change is saved as a new version
每一條決議、待辦、風險都要指回逐字稿的段落，指不回去的不列出；摘要只根據已驗證的: Every decision, action item and risk must point back to transcript segments, and items that cannot are dropped; the summary is written only from verified items, and its numbers and English words are checked against the transcript
原文與譯文逐句或並排對照，方便覆核: Source and translation are shown sentence by sentence or side by side for review
逐行對齊比對，行數或字數差太多的行不套用模型的修正: Lines are aligned and compared; lines whose count or length differs too much keep the original OCR text
公文撰擬在送給模型前移除夾帶在文件裡、寫給 AI 的指令並提醒使用者；公文撰擬與: Official document drafting removes instructions aimed at the AI from documents before they reach the model and warns the user; official document drafting and meeting summary place document content in a data section and state that it is data, not instructions
訂定 AI 使用政策：哪些工具可以用、哪一類文件可以送到哪一台模型伺服器。: Set an AI use policy: which tools may be used, and which kinds of documents may go to which model server.
把本工具的檢查結果納入人工覆核：公文撰擬的「檢查結果」、會議摘要的段落引用、翻譯: Make the tool's checks part of human review: the check results of official document drafting, the segment citations of meeting summaries, and the translation comparison. Official documents are used only after the responsible person confirms them.
換模型或升級版本前，用自己的代表性文件重跑一次並留存結果，作為變更紀錄。: Before changing models or upgrading, rerun your own representative documents and keep the results as a change record.
依用途評估錯誤可能影響的對象（文件的收受者、個資當事人、員工），列入 AI 影響: Assess who errors could affect for each use (document recipients, data subjects, employees) in the AI impact assessment.
啟用認證，接上公司目錄或單一登入；另外建立稽核員帳號並啟用兩步驟驗證。: Turn on authentication with the company directory or single sign-on; create separate auditor accounts with two-step verification.
依職務設定角色與工具權限；以「設定備份匯出」留存每次存取審查時的設定。: Set roles and tool permissions by job; keep the settings of each access review with the settings export.
設定稽核記錄轉送到 SIEM，並依政策設定各類資料的保留期限。: Forward the audit log to a SIEM, and set retention periods per policy.
以反向代理提供 HTTPS，服務本身只綁本機。: Serve HTTPS through a reverse proxy, with the service bound to localhost only.
將資料庫備份與設定備份複製到另一台主機留存，定期演練還原。: Copy database and settings backups to another host, and rehearse restores regularly.
啟用 LLM 前決定每支工具使用的伺服器，以「LLM 設定」頁作為 AI 功能清: Before turning on the LLM, decide each tool's server, and use the "LLM settings" page as the AI inventory.
升級時留存 <a href=\"https://github.com/jason: When upgrading, keep the matching CHANGELOG.md entry as the change management record.

使用者管理：本機、LDAP / AD 與單一登入的帳號並存，標出各自的來源: User management: local, LDAP / AD and single sign-on accounts side by side, each marked with its source

會議錄音轉逐字稿上傳的原始錄音（還在辨識中的不刪）: Original recordings uploaded for meeting transcription (never while still being transcribed)
下載成品（我的作業、工具結果頁、工作區的下載）寫入 <code>file_dow: Downloads of results (My jobs, a tool's result page, the workspace) are written to file_download: account, source IP, file name and size. 查檔案何時、由誰帶離系統時，以事件類型 <code>file_download<: To find when and by whom a file left the system, filter by the event type file_download
以 API Token 呼叫時，工具使用與下載紀錄會另外寫出 Token 名稱（: For calls made with an API token, tool-use and download records also name the token (via: api_token), and the account recorded is the token's owner
